headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Do not use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans.

body.usage: Use for all data tables, json traces, logs, and numeric readouts.

colors.rules: Color is function only. 95% of UI must be monochrome. Use Signal Red for privacy leakage alerts, Warning Yellow for contradictions, Primary Blue for active tabs or routing paths.

visual_enhancers.borders: The 'Technical' Look: Use grid borders (border-collapse style). 1px solid borders everywhere. border-radius should be 0px (sharp edges). Avoid soft UI.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal shadows. Use subtle glows (drop-shadow) on warning/error badges or active nodes only.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: NO transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdowns, or overlays. Overlays must use bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md or solid bg-[#1A1A1A].

layouts.spacing_scale: Density is key. Use tight spacing within data cards (p-4), moderate between panels (gap-4 or gap-6).
layouts.grid_strategy: Mode B (High Density Grid). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Widgets must stretch using h-full and align-self: stretch.

patterns.dashboard_structure: Left sidebar for main navigation. Main area divided into prominent KPI strip (top), middle row for trends/experiment charts, and bottom area for logs/traces.
patterns.trace_view: Progressive disclosure. Split pane view: Left column for conversation/steps tree, Right column for step details, JSON payloads, and privacy scores.

shadcn_overrides.Card: Remove border-radius (rounded-none). Make borders 1px solid border-border. Remove default shadows.
shadcn_overrides.Button: Square edges, monospaced text, high-contrast hover states (e.g., hover:bg-white hover:text-black).
shadcn_overrides.Badge: Use for privacy levels (e.g., [SENSITIVE: REDACTED]). Monospaced, thin borders.
shadcn_overrides.Table: Dense. text-sm or text-xs. Striped rows or border-b between rows.
shadcn_overrides.general: Customize Shadcn primitives in .js/.jsx files (not .tsx) as the project uses JS.

data_visualization.charts: Use recharts. Monochrome lines/bars with accent colors only for anomalies (e.g., latency spikes in red).
data_visualization.graph_visualization: Use react-force-graph-2d for OKF Knowledge Repositories. Nodes colored by sensitivity level.

image_urls.description: Blue abstract data network graph. Use as a subtle low-opacity background for the 'Graph Visualizer' empty state.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA standards. Light text on dark bg. Text on accent colors must have high contrast (e.g., Black text on Yellow badge).
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing. Use kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a research-grade prototype dashboard for an ML/AI system. The UI must feel like a technical command center.
Adopt the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' dark mode archetype. Use sharp edges (rounded-none), raw data presentation, and monospaced typography for metrics.
Implement a stable dashboard grid. Avoid scrolling within small widgets; let the page dictate scroll, or strictly overflow-y-auto the trace details panel.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide (stroke-width 1.5). Keep them sparse. Use data-testid on all interactive elements.
Design the Privacy Audit Dashboard and Trace Viewer using progressive disclosure: overview lists on the left, detailed JSON/metadata on the right.
Ensure all Shadcn components and custom UI files are authored in .js or .jsx extensions (NO .tsx).
Install and use `recharts` for cost/latency graphs and `react-force-graph-2d` for the OKF Graph Visualizer.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Never center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Always use modern button styles - for this app, sharp, technical buttons with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (e.g., table row hover, tab switch).
Use 2-3x more spacing in layout wrappers, but keep dense spacing inside data cards.
Prioritize existing Shadcn components, adjusting styles to match the technical, sharp-edge theme.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Follow mobile-first responsive design, even for complex data tables.
Always provide a visual state for empty data or loading screens.
Ensure error messages are descriptive, clear, and actionable.
All navigation elements must indicate their active state clearly.
Use high-contrast hover and focus states for keyboard accessibility.
MANDATORY: Add data-testid to every clickable element, form field, and major layout section for E2E testing.
